_readme: Fetched at runtime by src/services/ModelManifest.ts (raw content from the main branch). Bump an asset's 'version' whenever you change its 'url' — that's the only signal the app uses to detect an available update. NOTE on 'translator': Gemma3-1B-IT, chosen because it's explicitly documented as Android + MediaPipe LLM Inference ready (unlike TranslateGemma, which has no official mobile bundle). Filename/size cross-checked across independent sources but this environment's network policy blocks huggingface.co directly, so the URL itself hasn't had a live HTTP check, and it's unconfirmed whether the download requires an accepted Gemma license via a logged-in HuggingFace session. See ModelManifest.ts and TranslatorModule.kt for full detail.
